lines.en: I pace around the house.
I step behind the counter.

lines.zh: 我挪到窗边看街上的人
lines.en: I shuffle to the window and watch the street.
My boots thud on the floor.
I walk around a crate of arrows.
I go to the door, then come back.
I move between the shelves.
I walk a couple of steps with a bow.
I step in front of you.
I step outside to check the sky.
I walk along the wall to the far end.

lines.zh: 我慢慢坐在凳子上，又起来
lines.en: I sit on the stool, then get up.
I come around the other side of the room.
I walk to the crates and take stock.
I wipe down my bow.
This room is mine to live in.
I work a little oil into the crossbow string.
I am waiting for a buyer.
I sniff the powder.
My mood is fair enough.
I slacken the bowstring.
The light is poor in here.
I count the crates.
I lean on the counter.

lines.zh: 我把价钱在脑子里过了一遍
lines.en: I run the prices through my head.
No customers, and I am bored.
I set a knife where it can be seen.
I glance at the wall hanging.

lines.zh: 我把弓和弩都摆在你面前
lines.en: I've laid my bows and crossbows out for you.
My stock is on the racks.

lines.zh: 你看上去像是会用弓的
lines.en: You look like you can handle a bow.
Rotten flesh and string, and I can make a bow.
Three bones and string will get you a crossbow.
Which one are your eyes on?
Price is negotiable if you have goods.
Do you have coin on you?

lines.zh: 这间屋子是我住的地方
lines.en: This house is where I live.
I do not serve empty hands.

lines.zh: 你站着，我看看你带的东西
lines.en: Stand there and let me see your goods.
You are blocking the light in my shop.

lines.zh: 我这儿的东西都是好货
lines.en: Everything here is good stock.
If you are not buying, move aside.
Do not touch it; touching means paying.
I also take bones and string.
I back half a step behind the counter.
My shoulder slams into the shelf.
My stock nearly fell.
I steady myself on the counter.
You actually dared.
I wipe my mouth on my sleeve.
I have put that on the bill.
These two legs still hold me.
Do not hit my stock.
I have put this on your account.
That is not for eating.
Are you offering that in trade?
I do not buy this kind of thing.
How many coins is that worth?
Let me see what condition it is in.
String is what I could use.
This is worth little.
I am not short of food; I am short of stock.
Take it back and bring something proper.
What I want is rotten flesh and string.
You bumped into my counter.
Careful, the shelves are stocked.
Do not crowd, this is my shop.
You stepped on my bow.
I retreat behind the counter.
That knocked the arrows askew.
You have some strength in you.
Move, I need to get stock.
I catch the shelf.
You are not hurt, are you?
I am a trader.
No time for such things.
Close a deal first.
Only stock goes in this house.
In this shop I talk business, nothing else.
Enough, name a price.
I wave my hand: no more of that.
Not my concern.
Ask someone else.
I go back to wiping my bow.
I keep what falls.

lines.zh: 我看这破铜烂铁值几个子
lines.en: I'd say this scrap is worth a few coppers.
I'll give you three tenths of the price at most.
I will put it on the shelf and see.
I will have to discount this.
Whoever dropped it, it is mine to start.

lines.zh: 我掂着，这分量抵一把弩
lines.en: I weigh it: this much is worth a crossbow.
Nobody is likely to buy this.
I stuff it in a crate.
I hang this short blade behind the counter.
You touched my rack.
I am watching both your hands.
Are you buying or robbing?
I have snatched up a bow.
In this house, I decide.
Step over to the door.
I count three breaths.
I do not serve robbers.
Move again and see.
This is my shop.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没离开你的手
lines.en: My eyes have not left your hands.
My hand is under the counter.
You have edged toward the door.
I do not like that look.
I am judging the distance.
I have a crossbow and a bow.
You will not get far outside.

lines.zh: 我的弩一直对着柜台前
lines.en: My crossbow stays aimed past the counter.
My fingers are on the string.
Last time: put it down.
I swing my arm round once.
That was a lesson.
You are shoved out the door.
My bow catches your blow.
Do not start a fight in my shop.
I shove you again.
The shelves are knocked crooked.
That one is free.
You are out in the street.
Come in again and I use arrows.
I have moved all my goods in.
This house is finally fit to live in.
I set my crates on the counter.
I have opened a shop here.
The room is big enough, light is decent.
Sign is up; now I wait for custom.
I hang my bow on the wall.
The desert is not far from here.
I stack the arrows in bundles.

lines.zh: 我在门口看了看这条街
lines.en: I look up and down the street.
Fire catches the cloth on the shelf.
I fall down the steps.
Where did water come from in here?
The blast tips my crates over.
An arrow sticks in the counter.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的弓弦烧断了
lines.en: Magic burns through my bowstring.
I have not eaten today.

lines.zh: 雷打在屋顶上，瓦片掉下来
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof and tiles fall.
The floor is gone.
